alt: Three of each product — body lotion, deodorant, toothpaste and bar soap — so there is nothing to reorder for months.
note: Byte-identical copy of the unscoped render. The theme scopes gallery media by alt-text suffix and its gang_exist flag is sticky across the media loop, so an unscoped image sitting after a scoped one is hidden for EVERY variant. Universal frames must therefore exist once per kit.
